hypotheses.justification: T2Space G follows from the other assumptions [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]. Mathlib has the instance `TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space` (Mathlib/Topology/Separation/Connected.lean), which makes any totally disconnected space T1, so `isClosed_singleton : IsClosed ({1} : Set G)` holds. Mathlib's `IsTopologicalGroup.t2Space_iff_one_closed : T2Space G ↔ IsClosed ({1} : Set G)` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean) needs only Group, TopologicalSpace and IsTopologicalGroup, so it gives T2Space G. The only use of T2Space in the proof is as an instance argument of `quotientMapOfLE_exists_continuous_section_of_isClosed`. Adding `haveI : T2Space G := IsTopologicalGroup.t2Space_iff_one_closed.2 isClosed_singleton` at the start of the proof (with `omit [T2Space G] in` on the theorem) supplies it. The rest of the proof stays the same. No degenerate case matters, since the argument works for every group, including the trivial one.
